questions.stem: An elevator test payload has momentum p=-8 kg m/s at t=0 and p=-4 kg m/s at t=2 s (upward is positive). Without assuming its direction of travel equals the force direction, what is the direction of the net force on the payload?

options.A: Upward, because its signed momentum is becoming less negative.
options.B: Downward, because it is still moving downward.
options.C: Zero, because momentum remains negative.
options.D: The sign of the force cannot be known without its distance travelled.

qrt_contract.protected_work_W: Deceleration while descending is upward acceleration, not upward velocity.

rival_demands.rejection_rationale: Requires dynamic physical reasoning, not isolated recall.

factor_evidence.system_coupling: Score 1: Track one elevator payload.
factor_evidence.vector_dimensionality: Score 2: Downward signed momentum increases toward zero on an upward-positive axis.
factor_evidence.constraint_latency: Score 1: Both momentum observations and time interval are explicit.
factor_evidence.domain_coupling: Score 2: Relate a two-point momentum slope to net force direction.
factor_evidence.math_friction: Score 1: Only the sign of a single linear difference is needed.

A.diagnostic: Momentum slope Δp/Δt=(−4−(−8))/2=+2 N; net force points upward although the payload can still descend.

B.diagnostic: Applies a rule without the required signed state or actual force ownership.

C.diagnostic: Confuses a vector state, direction or external physical quantity.

D.diagnostic: Omits the physical boundary or balance that controls the result.

questions.stem: Three beads A, B and C sit at different radii on a speeding-up horizontal turntable. Two taut radial strings connect A-B and B-C. Each bead can lose static grip independently. Which collection of three free-body diagrams and constraints is physically complete BEFORE you calculate tensions or angular speed?

options.B: Every bead has only outward friction; tangential acceleration is irrelevant.
options.C: Both tensions point inward on B and therefore cancel before any FBD.
options.D: The disk-bead assembly is force free so no contact inequalities are needed.
